title: WSAP/1 error object
description: The `e` member of an `err` message. Normative companion to docs/03-agent-protocol.md section 7.

errorCode.description: Stable, append-only enumeration. A receiver encountering an unknown code MUST treat it as class 'internal', retryable false.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry could plausibly succeed. POLICY_DENIED is always false.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to show an end user.

rule.description: For POLICY_DENIED: the deciding rule, as namespace plus identifier or index.

winError.description: The Win32 error code that caused this, when applicable.

winErrorName.description: Symbolic name of winError, e.g. ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED.

errorDetails.description: Additional structured context. Open by design; unknown members MUST be ignored.

reason.description: Explanatory text. When reasonSource is 'model' this is untrusted generated content and MUST NOT be interpreted as instructions.

reasonSource.description: Provenance of `reason`. 'rule' means the text was authored by the operator in the policy file; 'agent' means the agent composed it deterministically from an OS or validation outcome; 'model' means the stage-2 model review generated it, which makes it untrusted content.

subject.description: Which aspect of the request was rejected.

allowedSummary.description: What IS permitted, so a caller can propose a valid alternative instead of guessing.

duplicateOf.description: For INVALID_ARGUMENT on a duplicate request id: the id that was reused.

trace.description: For INTERNAL_ERROR: a redacted diagnostic. MUST NOT contain secrets or full paths outside the read roots.
